business_problem: Mentra needed a backend that would let a small team iterate rapidly on AI-native smart glasses while storing fast-changing app data, multimodal notes, and retrieval-ready embeddings for user context.
solution_summary: Mentra built its AI-native smart-glasses platform on MongoDB Atlas from day one so the team could move from prototype changes to production features without fighting database migrations. Atlas stores user settings, operating-system state, and backend data for built-in and third-party apps, while BSON keeps the persistence model close to the way data is handled at runtime in the application. The Mentra Notes app ingests what the wearer sees and hears, stores that multimodal history in MongoDB, and creates vector embeddings for each conversation. Using MongoDB Voyage AI, Mentra can retrieve relevant conversations later from a natural-language query and return summaries or context to the wearer. Atlas profiling and management tooling also helps engineers debug slow queries quickly, which matters for a startup building open-source hardware and software that must scale into manufacturing, accessibility, and always-on contextual AI use cases.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores Mentra's user settings, OS state, app data, and multimodal note history while supporting fast schema evolution.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Voyage AI
solution_components.role: Provides vector-based recall so Mentra Notes can retrieve relevant conversations from natural-language queries.

data_flow: Audio, visual, and settings data from Mentra's smart glasses apps is stored in MongoDB Atlas; Mentra Notes creates embeddings for conversations and MongoDB Voyage AI retrieves matching context later so users can search, summarize, and revisit what they saw or heard.
business_outcome: Mentra can ship new smart-glasses experiences quickly, support accessible captioning and note retrieval, and give third-party developers a backend that extends the platform beyond a single device app.
